title: The Waste Strikes Back
next_chapter_hook: Lin Xiao's face was thoroughly disgraced, his fingertips quietly crushing the communication jade slip in his sleeve—the secret communications had already begun.

text.content:
The morning wind at the Martial Arena carried a chill, stirring the hem of Chen Ji's servant's robe. He stood on the Arena Platform, the smile at the corner of his lips still unfaded, like the last slanting rays of autumn sun, which should have been dim, yet inexplicably piercing to the eyes.

Lin Xiao stared at that calm face, the unnamed fire in his heart burning more fiercely. Three years ago, when this boy was demoted to the Servants' Quarters, he had witnessed that servile appearance—the boy kneeling on the ground, trembling, not even having the courage to raise his head and look at someone.

On what grounds? On what grounds does he dare look at me like this after three years?

"Chen Ji." Lin Xiao's voice was pressed low, yet his footsteps were deliberately heavy, "Do you think winning a few wild matches can make you put on airs in front of me?"

dialogue.content:
Among the crowd below the platform, Han Lie, the first genius of the Xuanwu Sect, stood with arms crossed, his black battle robe rustling in the wind. His gaze swept over Chen Ji's gaunt figure, his brow furrowed almost imperceptibly.

"That waste actually dares to come up?" Han Lie sneered, yet his voice wasn't deliberately lowered, "If Lin Xiao doesn't bring him down within three moves, I'll write my surname backwards."

text.content:
A wave of附和 laughter rose around. Outer Disciple/Servant of the Tianqing Sect—these five words were本身就是笑话. Everyone present was an elite carefully cultivated by the sect; yet Chen Ji hadn't even learned more than a few moves of formal techniques, what did he have to compete with Lin Xiao, a top-ten Inner Disciple genius?

Chen Ji lowered his eyes, seemingly looking at the blue stone floor beneath his feet, yet seemingly seeing nothing. He knew all eyes in the arena were on him—some mocking, some curious, some coldly observing.

Only he himself knew that within those eyes as still as dead water, they were reflecting the scene three hours later—Lin Xiao kneeling on the ground, his face full of disbelief.

dialogue.content:
"Lin Senior Brother speaks truly." Chen Ji slowly raised his head, his voice unhurried, "I indeed only practice the wild path, and might very well admit defeat within three moves."

His tone was too calm, as calm as stating an irrelevant fact. This反而让 Lin Xiao更加恼火— what he wanted was not such perfunctory responses, but fear! Pleading! The模样 thattrash kneeling on the ground trembling should have!

"Less nonsense!" Lin Xiao猛地踏前一步, spiritual energy气势suddenly爆发, "Today I shall cleanse the sect for you!"

text.content:
Spiritual energy erupted like a storm, Lin Xiao formed seals with both hands, a fierce sword aura breaking through the air. The watching disciples all changed expressions— this was the Tianqing Sect's introductory sword technique "Green Cloud Thirteen Style," yet Lin Xiao had used the third form right from the start, clearly intending a quick victory!

The sword aura howled closer, yet Chen Ji still stood in place.

"It's over, this waste is terrified silly!"

"He didn't even dodge?"

Uproar below the platform. However, just as the sword aura was about to touch Chen Ji's form—

His eyes, changed.

choice.prompt: The sword aura is about to arrive, how does Chen Ji choose to respond?

choices.text: Sidestep to dodge, using softness to overcome hardness
choices.description: Avoid the blade's edge, consume Lin Xiao's spiritual energy, wait for flaws to appear
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, let the enemy underestimate
choices.risk_hint: Might be considered a fluke escape

text.content:
Chen Ji's form swayed slightly, precisely moving half a step left in the instant before the sword aura reached him. That sword aura grazed past his right shoulder, lifting a few strands of broken hair, yet not even touching the hem of his clothes.

"Hiss— that was close!" Someone exclaimed.

Yet Chen Ji's expression held no relief of escaping death; he simply gazed calmly at Lin Xiao, like watching a beast that had missed its pounce.

choices.text: Receive the sword aura head-on, crush with absolute strength
choices.description: Shatter enemy confidence with absolute strength, create the most shocking effect
choices.visible_reward: Greatly intimidate everyone present, reputation skyrockets

text.content:
Chen Ji did not dodge.

He didn't even raise his hand, only slightly turned his body, allowing that fierce sword aura to slash toward his chest.

"Seeking death!" A fierce light flashed in Lin Xiao's eyes, the sword aura suddenly intensifying by three parts.

However, in the next moment, his pupils contracted sharply— that sword aura striking Chen Ji's chest was like striking a piece of ten-thousand-year dark iron, sparks flying, Chen Ji's lapel was torn open, revealing a layer of inner armor faintly glowing with cyan light.

"...Body-protecting spiritual armor?" Someone below the platform inhaled sharply, "Where would a servant disciple get something like this?"

choices.description: At the moment Lin Xiao's move was exhausted, use bizarre movement skills to directly target weaknesses
choices.visible_reward: Quick battle to the end, maximally humiliate the opponent
choices.risk_hint: Might expose traces of Tianji Record related abilities

text.content:
Just as everyone thought Chen Ji would be sent flying by the sword aura, he moved.

His form rushed forward like a ghost, speed so fast leaving an afterimage in place. In the next instant, Chen Ji had already appeared beside Lin Xiao, his right index finger pointing toward the opponent's sword-wielding wrist.

This finger held no spiritual energy fluctuation, yet was precise as if rehearsed a thousand times.

Lin Xiao's wrist was struck, his long sword flying from his grip. He couldn't even react before Chen Ji had circled behind him, a palm striking his back—

"Get down."

Lin Xiao's body uncontrollably lunged forward, falling heavily at the edge of the arena. He struggled to rise, yet found his legs as if stripped of bones, unable to exert force.

How is this possible?

He clearly felt that palm was light as a feather, even without any spiritual energy invading his body, yet why wouldn't his own body obey?

"Lin Senior Brother, are you alright?" Chen Ji's voice came from behind, warm as if caring for an injured old friend.

But this warmth, falling in Lin Xiao's ears, was more irritating than any mockery.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji slowly walked to Lin Xiao's front, lowering his head to look at this once-invincible opponent. Morning light fell from behind him, stretching his shadow long, precisely covering Lin Xiao.

"Speaking of which, I must thank Senior Brother Lin for his guidance back then." Chen Ji's voice was very soft, only audible to the two of them, "If not for Senior Brother demoting me to the Servants' Quarters, I wouldn't have had today's fortune."

Lin Xiao's pupils contracted sharply: "You... you knew all along?"

"Knew what?" Chen Ji tilted his head slightly, revealing an innocent smile, "Knew that I would win today?"

text.content:
Lin Xiao's fingernails deeply embedded in his palms, blood dripping between his fingers. He had been praised as a genius since childhood, when had he ever suffered such humiliation? Being defeated by a waste in public was one thing, yet the other party was actually thanking him for his "cultivation"?

This was slapping his face!

"Chen Ji—" Lin Xiao ground his teeth, voice挤出 from between his teeth, "Don't enjoy yourself too much! My master is Elder Ling Yuan, if you dare touch me, the Tianqing Sect won't tolerate you!"

Upon hearing the name "Ling Yuan," a flash of cold light, hard to detect, flickered through Chen Ji's eyes, then returned to calm.

choice.prompt: Facing Lin Xiao's threat, how does Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Continue mocking, killing the spirit while slaying the flesh
choices.description: Use words to thoroughly crush Lin Xiao's psychological defenses, making him lose all face

text.content:
"Elder Ling Yuan?" Chen Ji laughed lightly, "Lin Senior Brother, I remember you were only sixteen when you entered the sect, and when Elder Ling Yuan took you as a personal disciple, you were only at Foundation Building middle stage. Now three years have passed, and you're still at Foundation Building middle stage—"

He squatted down, eye-level with Lin Xiao, voice pressed even lower: "A 'genius' who hasn't made a single step of progress in three years, do you think Elder Ling Yuan will stand up for you? Or would he think you're hopeless waste?"

Lin Xiao's face instantly turned deathly pale.

choices.text: Stop at the right point, turn and leave
choices.description: Show grace, leave Lin Xiao face, secretly observe Ling Yuan's reaction
choices.visible_reward: Avoid exposing too much edge too early
choices.risk_hint: Might be considered a fluke victory

text.content:
Chen Ji said nothing more, only slowly stood up, brushing dust from his robes that wasn't there.

"Today's match, I am the victor." His voice was calm without a trace of waves, "Lin Senior Brother, rest well. Another day I shall seek instruction from Senior Brother."

Having said this, he turned and walked toward the platform steps, his back composed and unhurried.

Yet it was precisely this composure that made Lin Xiao even more uncomfortable—the opponent didn't even bother to glance at him again, as if he were merely an irrelevant passerby.

choices.description: Make Lin Xiao's old scandals public knowledge, completely destroy his future
choices.risk_hint: May offend more of Lin Xiao's associates

text.content:
Chen Ji did not lower his voice.

"By the way, all brothers and sisters present, do you still remember the incident from three years ago?" His gaze swept across the crowd, "Back then, Senior Brother Lin, in order to compete for a Foundation Building Pill, framed an Outer Disciple for theft, causing that disciple to have their cultivation abolished and be expelled from the sect."

Uproar below the platform.

"Later, where did that Foundation Building Pill go?" Chen Ji added nonchalantly, "It seems it was 'picked up' by Senior Brother Lin."

Lin Xiao's face instantly turned ashen, the gazes of the watching disciples gradually becoming strange.

Silence reigned over the arena.

Everyone was stunned. That waste servant disciple they had mocked for three years had actually, in broad daylight, beaten an Inner Sect top-ten genius disciple so utterly that he couldn't fight back?

"This... how is this possible?"

"Am I seeing things? Lin Xiao was actually defeated by a servant?"

"Those few moves just now, I didn't even see how he struck..."

Whispers spread like tidewaters, disbelief written on every face. Yet Chen Ji still stood in place, morning light plating his gaunt figure with a faint golden rim.

dialogue.content:
Among the crowd, Han Lie's gaze turned grave.

He had originally thought this was merely a boring crush match, that Lin Xiao would within three moves send that waste into the dust. But the result?

"Interesting." Han Lie murmured to himself, the fists beneath his black battle robe unconsciously tightening, "This Chen Ji... definitely not as simple as he appears."

He recalled a rumor he had heard from a certain senior— the Tianji Record Fragment, it seemed, was right here in the Tianqing Sect...

text.content:
At this moment, atop the arena's highest viewing platform, several gazes also fell upon Chen Ji.

The Tianqing Sect's Grand Elder slightly narrowed his eyes, deep in thought. Another white-bearded Elder stroked his beard, casting a meaningful glance toward where Ling Yuan sat.

And Ling Yuan—that elder who had always worn a kind facade watching the juniors spar—at this moment had all smiles completely vanished, replaced by an unnoticeable gloom.

Lin Xiao was his disciple. Lin Xiao lost, equal to slapping his face.

More importantly, this boy named Chen Ji, back then had been personally marked by him as "unteachable" and demoted to the Servants' Quarters...

Chen Ji seemed to sense something, raising his head to look toward the viewing platform. His gaze briefly met Ling Yuan's, the corners of his mouth slightly raised.

That smile, falling in Ling Yuan's eyes, actually made this great cultivator at the Core Formation stage生出一丝莫名的寒意.

"Chen Ji..." Ling Yuanwhispered念着 this name, his eyes' gloom deepening, "That matter from back then, could something have gone wrong?"

His right hand unconsciously touched inside his sleeve, where an ancient token never parted from his body lay hidden. On the back of the token, faintly carved was a blurry rune—

That was the mark of the Tianji Record Fragment.

dialogue.content:
At the same time, an elderly and ethereal voice rang in Chen Ji's mind:

"Little one, well done." That was Mo Xiansheng's voice, carrying a hint of relief, "But the edge you revealed today has already attracted some attention."

Chen Ji responded calmly in his heart: "Isn't this exactly what you wished to see?"

Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment,似乎在笑: "Old me only reminds you— the chess game has begun, a move once made cannot be undone. Ling Yuan will certainly make his move next. That 'old friend's' descendant, won't take this lying down."

text.content:
Chen Ji did not respond to Mo Xiansheng further.

His gaze returned to Lin Xiao on the arena. At this moment Lin Xiao had already been helped down by fellow disciples, yet those eyes burned with hatred, almost wanting to devour him.

Hate. The more hatred the better.

Chen Ji thought silently in his heart. Three years ago when you trampled me into the dust, had you thought of today? When you kneel before me begging in five years, I hope you can still maintain this pride.

He turned and walked toward the platform steps, his pace unhurried. The surrounding disciples all stepped aside to make way, their gazes transforming from mockery to reverence and wariness.

"Waste"?

From today onward, this word has nothing to do with him.

"Brother Chen Ji."

A cold voice came from the crowd. Chen Ji's footsteps paused, looking up— Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, had somehow appeared at the crowd's edge, quietly watching him.

Her gaze was complex and hard to decipher, containing scrutiny, inquiry, yet also an emotion Chen Ji couldn't read.

"In three days, there is a mission discussion in the Inner Sect." Su Qingyao's voice carried no emotion, "As today's match victor, you have the qualification to attend."

Having said this, she turned and left, her back cold as frost.

Chen Ji watched her retreating figure, a faint smile appearing at the corner of his lips.

Su Qingyao... finally unable to stay still?

The crowd gradually dispersed, the Martial Arena returning to its usual calm.

Yet beneath this calm, undercurrents had already begun to surge.

In a corner, Lin Xiao, supported by two fellow disciples, his face ashen pale. His lips trembled slightly,似乎在whispered说着什么.

"...Master... will surely avenge me..."

His right hand quietly slipped into his sleeve, crushing that communication jade slip. A spiritual light unnoticeable to others instantly vanished into the void, speeding toward some unknown direction.

Chen Ji seemed to sense something, glancing back toward Lin Xiao's direction.

In those eyes as calm as still water, a truly genuine smile finally appeared—

Come. Let me see what tricks you still have left.

The morning wind gradually stilled, sunlight grew stronger.

This insignificant match at the Tianqing
